summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a 727KB obfuscated payload
details: @ornikar/babel-preset-kitt-universal@8.0.8 advertises itself as a Babel preset (lib/index.js is ~16 lines) but its package.json preinstall runs setup.mjs, itself obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style _0x identifiers and string dictionaries. setup.mjs constructs a URL to github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/, downloads and extracts the Bun runtime, chmod +x's the bun binary, and then execFileSync's it against a bundled math_init.js at npm install time. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line heavily obfuscated JavaScript file (hex-named variables, large numeric/string dictionaries, shift/rotate string-array decoder) that is not referenced by lib/index.js and has no role in a Babel preset. The alternate-runtime execution routes the opaque payload through Bun rather than Node, evading Node-based inspection, and the behavior fires automatically on npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
